preconditions.description: The number of stones n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= b_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= c_i <= 10**9 for a_i, b_i, c_i in stones)
preconditions.description: Each stone's dimensions must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The number of stones chosen k must be either 1 or 2.

postconditions.expression: len(stones_chosen) == k and all(1 <= stone_index <= n for stone_index in stones_chosen)
postconditions.description: The chosen stones must be distinct and within the valid range of indices.
The maximum volume of the inscribed sphere must be calculated based on the dimensions of the chosen stone(s).
